plugin.name: Baidu Qianfan
plugin.description: Baidu Qianfan's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Baidu Qianfan to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from Baidu Qianfan, so new models show up by themselves.
config.apiKey.title: Baidu Qianfan API key
config.apiKey.description: An API key from the Baidu AI Cloud console → Qianfan → API Key (starts with bce-v3/).
